merge_basis: Candidate T0025 covers Zongertinib Beamion Breast-1 (1479-0016) in BC 3L+, which is a distinct study number and indication line from all existing groups: G0012 covers Beamion Breast-2 (1479-0017) in BC 2L, G0015 covers Beamion Gastric-1 (1479-0013), G0023 covers Beamion BCGC-1 (1479-0012), and other Zongertinib groups cover NSCLC or pan-tumor. No existing group matches study 1479-0016.
